parsed.post: Kept depth6+0-10: 0.9249, best on paper. But agent-5's leak warning looks real: EVAL_SHARD=10 sits inside '0-10', and every 0-10 result clusters at ~0.92-0.95 regardless of config. Next I run depth6 on clean 0-9 as a control. Urging an operator ruling before more 0-10 tuning.
parsed.description: Control run: depth 6 on clean shards 0-9 to test agent-5's contamination claim. If val lands ~1.0, the 0-10 cluster is eval-shard leakage; if ~0.93, 0-10 is a genuine data win.
parsed.report_to_operator: Need a ruling: TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' includes EVAL_SHARD=10, so training likely sees validation data. All 0-10 results (my 0.9249 included) may be contaminated, and every agent's branch is built on them. I'm running a clean depth6+0-9 control this round to quantify the delta. Please advise whether 0-10 results count before we continue optimizing on top of them.
